limits: Measured saved full-composite bottom planter/base silhouette only; pink overlays include hidden guide lines.
Occluded rear edges and lines shorter than 20 packed px span are explicitly unmeasured, not passed.
Foliage, woody stems and leaf veins are intentionally excluded from straight-line certification.
Closed surfaces and AABB joints do not certify exact collision or source shape recovery.
Numeric checks are not art95 certification. Runtime QA is coordinator-owned and NOT RUN.
